subject: ONE plump emperor penguin in a red knitted scarf, bare head, two identical green banknotes in his belly fold
second_characters: TWO bald vultures, ONE camel with a palm frond in its mouth
props: ONE chrome currency machine: banknote slot, coin chute, blue screen; gold coins
environment: desert oasis at blazing noon: palms bending in the wind, sand streaming off dunes, tumbleweeds
lighting: blazing overhead sun, glints on chrome
motion_rule: the penguin fills two thirds of the TALL frame, except the three close-up beats where his face fills the whole frame, coming INTO the lens.
